channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israel locks down occupied West Bank after Hebron shooting
item.description: Israel has imposed a lockdown across the occupied West Bank after a shooting near Hebron killed two Israeli soldiers.

item.title: Romania blames Russia after drone sinks ship in the Black Sea
item.description: One sailor killed and three others missing after Comoros-flagged Khoryv hit near Romanian waters.

item.title: European, Middle East ministers urge US-Iran diplomacy, not new attacks
item.description: An escalation would 'create nothing but losers', French foreign minister says as US official warns of possible strike.

item.title: One person killed in suspected ‘Islamophobic’ shooting near Paris
item.description: Antiterrorism prosecutors investigating motive of attack that seriously wounded five, including a 12-year-old girl.

item.title: ‘Foreign policy is the economy’: How Iran war is shaping US midterm vote
item.description: Democrats are framing the conflict as an affordability issue to criticise Republican candidates backed by Trump.

item.title: Finland nearing opening of world’s first permanent nuclear waste repository
item.description: Facilities are being built in many countries, but Finland is the first to licence its underground storage facility.

item.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
item.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

item.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
item.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

item.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
item.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.
